items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: That's Biggs. That's Joe Benuti playing violin. ... But we were ahead of the time with this orchestra.

ctx.x: Well, what happened after this record's made? Huh? What happened after you made this record? Well, the band Disbanded.

That's the last record that they made. That's Biggs. That's Joe Benuti playing violin. Now, in the choruses, when I slap the bass, you'll notice a difference. See, it's a difference in the way they're playing now, see? See, they just... They pick the bass and they don't let the strings hit, see? They just get the tone. But I used to do that. I used to slap it to get a rhythm at the tempo. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. But I used to do that, I used to slap it to get a rhythm…

I heard those on the high five. Boy that bass comes out loud as hell. You can hear it there too. That's Spiegel Wilcox, see. Beautiful tone there. I knew that clarinet play. He's dead now. Yeah. Yeah. Oh no. On this particular record. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
